verdict.rationale: Airbyte handles customer data and ships AI features such as the Connector Builder AI Assistant and Airbyte Agents, so asking whether it offers an AI-training opt-out or no-training guarantee is a fair question. The evidence pack contains no policy, setting or contractual statement that customer data is excluded from model training. Self-hosting options (OSS quickstart, abctl, Kubernetes) are a deployment choice, not a documented training-prevention capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
